original_abstract.text: Modern recommender systems rely on generative retrieval techniques to predict the next item either as discrete codes or as a continuous vector. On the one hand, Semantic IDs (SIDs) give discrete models shared parameters and pretrained semantic structure, but discretizing items into hard codes discards some information from the original content embeddings. On the other hand, continuous models avoid quantization, yet typically use flat item lookup tables with no explicit parameter tying across items. We ask whether a continuous recommender can introduce shared structure without making it a discrete bottleneck. We propose CAP-Mix, a flow recommender that represents each item as a soft mixture of shared prototypes plus an item-specific vector. The assignments, prototypes, and item vectors are trained jointly, and the soft representation is retained at inference. Pretrained information is optional: SID responsibilities can serve as a prior over assignments, while a full content embedding can initialize the item-specific vector without changing the initial flat table. In matched comparisons on three datasets, CAP-Mix improves over a flat table on the two sparse Amazon datasets and yields a small gain on Steam when trained without pretrained information. Given only an offline SID, it outperforms a hard table built from the same tokenizer by 4.45-14.90% in HR@5. Given the full content embedding, it matches or improves a strong flat table while hard assignments regress on the sparse Amazon datasets. Overall, averaged across six benchmarks, CAP-Mix improves HR@5 and NDCG@5 by 6.9% and 13.6% relative to the best evaluated baseline for each dataset and metric, while delivering 1.4-161x the inference throughput of the discrete baselines in our experiments.
original_abstract.source_title: Item Representations Matter: Bridging Hard Semantic IDs and Soft Prototype Mixtures for Generative Retrieval

en.text: CAP-Mix gives continuous generative retrieval shared item structure without a hard discrete bottleneck. Each item combines a soft mixture of shared prototypes with an item-specific vector; assignments, prototypes and vectors train jointly and remain soft at inference, with optional semantic-ID priors or content initialization. Matched comparisons examine sparse Amazon and Steam settings. Across six benchmarks the authors report average HR@5 and NDCG@5 gains of 6.9% and 13.6% over each metric's best evaluated baseline, with throughput depending on the discrete baseline.

zh.text: CAP-Mix用共享原型的软混合加物品专属向量来表示物品，让连续生成召回获得跨物品参数共享，同时保留推理时的软表示。分配权重、原型和物品向量联合训练，也可用语义ID先验或内容向量初始化。论文通过稀疏Amazon与Steam上的对齐实验分析软结构的收益，并在六个基准上报告相对各数据集最佳所测基线的平均HR@5和NDCG@5提升为6.9%与13.6%；吞吐优势依比较的离散基线而变。

original_abstract.text: Expert deactivation at inference time changes both token routing and expert weights, and its effect on performance depends on how these changes are implemented. We compare removal, freezing, remaining-expert renormalization, and unnormalized re-routing on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four model families, with a base OLMoE checkpoint as an additional comparison. We develop a weight-sum model that relates the loss of expert contributions and changes in branch scale to the weight rule used during training. With half of the experts deactivated according to activation-based rankings, remaining-expert renormalization yields the highest perplexity in models trained with raw router probabilities, whereas unnormalized re-routing yields the highest perplexity in models trained with normalized weights. Perplexity ranges from 1.4 to 73 times the intact baseline when the training rule is retained, and from 14 to 28,740 times the baseline under a rule mismatch. Task outcomes vary across evaluation types: on OLMoE, GSM8K strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. Extending the model to changes in the number of active experts yields a further prediction, supported by the OLMoE experiments: the perplexity penalty from additional renormalization increases as fewer experts are activated.
original_abstract.source_title: Matching the Training-Time Weight Rule in Inference-Time Expert Deactivation

en.text: This study isolates how expert deactivation interacts with the router weighting rule used in training. It compares removal, freezing, remaining-expert renormalization and unnormalized rerouting on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four families, plus a base OLMoE model. With half the experts disabled, retaining the training rule yields perplexity of 1.4–73x the intact baseline; mismatches yield 14–28,740x. Even matching the rule does not guarantee task quality: OLMoE GSM8K strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. Expert compression therefore needs routing-scale and task-level checks, not just expert importance rankings.

zh.text: 这项研究把专家停用的实现方式与训练时路由权重规则分开检查。在四个模型家族的五个指令微调checkpoint及一个基础OLMoE模型上，它对同一批停用专家比较移除、冻结、剩余专家重归一化和不归一化重路由。停用一半专家时，保留训练权重规则的困惑度为完整模型的1.4–73倍，规则错配时为14–28,740倍。但规则匹配也不保证任务效果：OLMoE的GSM8K严格匹配准确率在四种实现下都降到零。压缩专家时应同时检查路由尺度和任务指标，不能只依赖专家重要性排名。

original_abstract.text: As sequence lengths continue to grow, distributed attention based on sequence parallel (e.g., Ring-Attention) has become a mainstream solution for large language models (LLMs). Nevertheless, inherent communication dependencies limit computation-communication overlap, reducing GPU utilization. Moreover, in cross-hardware (NUMA or node) architectures, due to imbalanced communication bandwidth, frequent communication synchronization will limit overall performance. Based on these insights, we propose CHARM+, Cross-Hardware Attention with Re-Merge Multistream Mechanism. We reorganize sequential communications into several levels and achieve intra-level parallelism and computation overlap. Furthermore, we decouple cross-hardware communication from intra-hardware communication, eliminating synchronization overhead caused by bandwidth imbalance. Forward and backward algorithms were evaluated on multiple hardware architectures and consistently outperformed state-of-the-art methods. Compared to Ring-Attention, our forward and backward algorithms achieve average speedups of 1.3x and 1.7x on a dual-NUMA PCIe architecture, and 2.8x and 2.9x on a dual-node NVLink architecture, respectively.
original_abstract.source_title: CHARM+: Cross-Hardware Attention with Re-Merge Multistream Mechanism

en.text: CHARM+ reorganizes distributed long-sequence attention communication into levels to overlap transfers and computation. It separates cross-NUMA or cross-node exchanges from local communication to reduce synchronization under unequal bandwidth. Relative to Ring-Attention, reported average forward/backward speedups are 1.3x/1.7x on dual-NUMA PCIe and 2.8x/2.9x on dual-node NVLink systems. These are attention implementation measurements, with potential relevance to distributed long-history model training.

zh.text: CHARM+把分布式长序列注意力的串行通信重排成多个层级，增加同层并发与计算重叠，并把跨NUMA或跨节点交换同局部通信解耦，减少带宽不均造成的同步等待。相对Ring-Attention，作者报告双NUMA PCIe配置前向与反向平均加速1.3倍和1.7倍，双节点NVLink配置为2.8倍和2.9倍。这类通信调度可供长历史模型训练参考，数字对应论文的Attention实现实验。

original_abstract.text: Second-stage neural rankers are commonly applied with a fixed re-ranking depth, assuming that retrieval effectiveness saturates as depth increases. Prior research has questioned the assumption that increasing the re-ranking depth yields linear performance gains, further suggesting that optimal re-ranking depth varies considerably from query to query. In the past, studying such phenomena was methodologically difficult given the scale of manual annotation required. With the advent of LLM-based relevance judgments we can now more easily undertake such studies, in this case to pinpoint the optimal re-ranking depth on a per-query basis. Using dense LLM-based relevance judgments over a typical re-ranking pipeline, we show that many queries exhibit a well-defined optimal re-ranking depth, beyond which effectiveness stagnates or degrades. We formulate re-ranking depth as a query-specific property and study whether it can be predicted a priori from first-stage retrieval characteristics. Through a large-scale analysis, we find that most standard query performance prediction (QPP) methods are ineffective for this task. In contrast, a predictor derived from LLM-assessed first-stage ranking quality, which we term IR-DCG@10, can reduce the average re-ranking depth by up to a factor of 3 while preserving overall effectiveness, depending on the specific first- and second-stage rankers used. Under oracle selection of optimal depths, we further show that retrieval effectiveness can improve by more than 7% while reducing the average re-ranking depth by a factor of 5 on the MSMARCO DEV collection. Given our promising preliminary findings, we would encourage the use of automatic judgments to facilitate research otherwise infeasible under manual annotation. Towards this point, we release relevance judgments, our codebase, and experimental artefacts to support reproducibility and further research.
original_abstract.source_title: Optimal Re-Ranking Depth

en.text: This study treats reranking depth as query-dependent rather than fixed. Dense LLM relevance judgments reveal saturation or degradation beyond each query's preferred depth, while common query-performance predictors transfer poorly. An IR-DCG@10 predictor based on LLM-assessed first-stage quality reduces mean reranking depth by up to 3x while preserving effectiveness in the evaluated pipelines. Larger oracle improvements are upper bounds, and the judgments introduce a dependency on LLM assessment quality.

zh.text: 论文把重排深度视为查询相关的决策，借助密集LLM相关性标注发现：增加候选数量可能出现收益饱和甚至效果下降，常见查询性能预测方法也难以直接预测最优深度。由首阶段排序质量构造的IR-DCG@10预测器，在所测排序组合中最多把平均重排深度降低到约三分之一并保持效果。对推荐系统的启发是按请求分配重排计算量；Oracle结果仅代表上界，标注质量依赖LLM判断。

original_abstract.text: Hyper-Connections (HC) architectures are increasingly adopted in frontier language models, yet their components remain insufficiently understood and introduce non-negligible training overhead. In this work, we systematically study the HC architecture to understand its components and identify simpler, more efficient designs. We find that learned read/write gating without mixing and unconstrained mixing with fixed gates form two effective interaction groups: either alone achieves performance comparable to mHC. We also identify repeated access to the expanded residual state as a major source of training overhead, even without mixing. These findings lead to SimpleHC, which simplifies the architecture by removing residual mixing and simplifies execution through shared memory access, using the resulting additive structure and shared gate inputs. Layer-specific gates share a group-entry state, enabling batched reads and deferred writes; scalar corrections exactly preserve preceding sublayer output contributions. Our analyses support both the retained residual structure and the design of shared memory access. SimpleHC incurs only 2.4% extra end-to-end training time over a vanilla residual baseline at the largest tested scale. It maintains performance comparable to mHC when scaling from 15B to 30B MoE models, exhibits smoother gradient dynamics during standard training, and remains stable under stress. We hope SimpleHC will encourage a broader pursuit of simplicity in foundation model design, making performance gains more accessible and practical at scale.
original_abstract.source_title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability

en.text: SimpleHC studies which Hyper-Connection components justify their training cost. It removes residual mixing while retaining learned read/write gates, then shares memory access through batched reads and deferred writes with scalar corrections that preserve preceding update contributions. Across 15B–30B MoE models, it maintains performance comparable to mHC; at the largest tested scale, end-to-end training takes only 2.4% longer than a vanilla residual baseline. It also reports smoother training gradients and stability under stress. Separating useful residual-state structure from expensive memory access could guide deeper recommendation architectures, which are not tested here.

zh.text: SimpleHC研究Hyper-Connection中哪些结构值得付出训练开销。它移除残差混合，保留可学习的读写门，再通过批量读取、延后写回和标量校正共享内存访问，同时保留前序更新的贡献。在15B–30B MoE模型上，效果与mHC相当；最大测试规模下，端到端训练耗时仅比普通残差基线多2.4%，并报告更平滑的梯度和压力测试稳定性。把有效的残差状态结构与昂贵的内存访问拆开优化，可供深层推荐架构参考，论文未验证这一迁移。

original_abstract.text: Helping users discover new interests is vital to the long-term health of industrial recommender systems, yet the usual remedy, boosting exposure of under-explored (discovery) content, often backfires in production. We report URED (Unexposed Recycling for Efficient Discovery), a training-free recall-stage system serving Taobao feed recommendation at Alibaba for over six months to tens of millions of daily active users. It rests on a production-validated insight: naive boosting fails because it injects cold, information-poor candidates that rankers systematically over-estimate, buying no discovery gain while risking engagement. Items scored highly but never exposed (signals industrial pipelines routinely discard) form a pool that is both relevant and reliably predictable. Over a 30-day horizon URED aggregates them and re-injects at recall time through a lightweight pipeline spanning offline storage, distributed aggregation, and low-latency online serving, adding under 1% latency via a single O(1) lookup per request with no model retraining. Online A/B tests show +3.47% discovered categories and +8.47% content richness with engagement preserved: completion video views rise significantly (+2.62%) and total views move positive (+0.36%, not significant). Ablations confirm both design pillars are necessary: a one-day window collapses the discovery gain to +0.55% (not significant), and random injection without score filtering yields no gain while trending negative on engagement (-0.17%). Across production recall channels, URED reaches 13.9x the platform-average discovery rate (6.3x the strongest nearline baseline) at engagement quality on par with the platform average. We share deployment details and lessons for practitioners facing the exploration-exploitation dilemma under tight resource constraints.
original_abstract.source_title: From Waste to Discovery: Recycling High-Scored Unexposed Candidates in Taobao Feed Recommendation

en.text: URED reuses high-scored but unexposed items instead of injecting poorly understood cold candidates for discovery. A 30-day pool feeds a training-free recall pipeline with one O(1) lookup per request and under 1% added latency. In Taobao feed A/B tests, discovered categories rise 3.47% and completed video views rise 2.62%; the 0.36% total-view increase is not statistically significant. Shortening the pool to one day or removing score filtering removes the reliable discovery gain. The system illustrates how existing ranking signals can support exploration without another model, rather than demonstrating model-scaling gains.

zh.text: URED回收高分但未曝光的商品，用这些已有较可靠排序信号的候选做兴趣发现，避免直接注入信息不足的冷候选。系统汇总30天候选，无需重新训练，每次请求只做一次O(1)查找，新增延迟低于1%。淘宝信息流A/B测试中，发现品类增加3.47%，完播量增加2.62%；总播放量增加0.36%，未达统计显著。把窗口缩到一天，或去掉分数过滤，都不再有可靠的发现收益。可借鉴的是用现有排序信号低成本补充探索，而不是模型规模扩展结论。

original_abstract.text: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become prevailing, yet their distributed deployment suffers from severe dynamic load imbalance due to the conflict between static expert placement and inherent routing dynamism. While host DRAM offers capacity to avoid static device storage for load balancing, we identify existing offloading works fundamentally fail in distributed inference due to two overlooked challenges: (1) coupled performance impacts of runtime Host-to-Device transfers due to load dynamism and shared PCIe topology; (2) system-level memory overhead incurred by DRAM usage at scale. In this paper, we propose vExpert that shifts DRAM offloading paradigm from partial residency to full redundancy through virtualized expert storage. We pioneer the first systematic performance model that jointly captures H2D latency, PCIe contention, and load imbalance, building a lightweight allocator to dynamically map physical experts to virtual slots runtime. A novel disaggregated manager is designed to reduce memory overhead in multi-process environments. Evaluated on DeepSeek-V3.1 within an 8-node H100 cluster, vExpert improves load balance ratio by up to 55% and achieves 1.2$\times$ end-to-end speedup.
original_abstract.source_title: vExpert: Virtualizing Expert Storage for Adaptive Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference

en.text: vExpert addresses the mismatch between static expert placement and dynamic MoE routing. It keeps fully redundant expert storage in host DRAM, virtualizes GPU expert slots and uses a performance model covering host-to-device transfers, PCIe contention and load imbalance to choose mappings. A separate manager reduces multiprocess host-memory overhead. On DeepSeek-V3.1 in an eight-node H100 cluster, the system reports up to 55% improvement in its load-balance ratio and 1.2x end-to-end speedup. The design offers a systems approach to dynamic expert placement; its recommendation applicability and behavior on other interconnects remain untested in the abstract.

zh.text: vExpert处理静态专家放置跟不上MoE动态路由的问题。它在主机DRAM中保存完整冗余专家，把GPU上的专家位置虚拟化，再用同时考虑H2D传输、PCIe争用和负载不均的性能模型分配映射；独立管理器减少多进程主机内存开销。在8节点H100集群上运行DeepSeek-V3.1时，论文报告其负载均衡比指标最多改善55%，端到端提速1.2倍。动态专家放置的方法可供稀疏推荐系统参考，摘要未验证推荐任务或其他互连环境。

original_abstract.text: The full-attention layers of large language models (LLMs) make every generated token more expensive than the previous one, slowing models down on long-context tasks. Hybrid models reduce this cost by replacing most full-attention layers with linear-attention layers, but the first still dominate decoding at long contexts. We accelerate these remaining layers without any training or weight changes using combined sparse attention: each layer attends to a sliding window of recent tokens, a pinned prefix, and a fixed budget of most relevant tokens in the context. The window size and budget are found on a per-layer basis using a multi-objective search algorithm. Across six hybrid models from three families, from 4B to 397B parameters, the selected configurations preserve their baseline model's accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. Decoding 64k/256k tokens becomes up to 1.26x/2.22x faster on Qwen3.5-4B, 1.20x/2.23x on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 1.16x/2.06x on Ornith-1.0-397B.
original_abstract.source_title: Accelerating Long-Context Decoding in Large-Scale Hybrid LLMs Without Retraining

en.text: This method sparsifies the remaining full-attention layers in hybrid LLMs without retraining or changing weights. Each layer retains a recent window, a pinned prefix and a fixed budget of relevant context tokens, with per-layer settings chosen by multi-objective search. Across six models from three families, spanning 4B–397B parameters, selected configurations preserve baseline accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. At 256K context, reported decoding speedups reach 2.22x on Qwen3.5-4B, 2.23x on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B and 2.06x on Ornith-1.0-397B. Layer-specific sparse budgets offer a design to test for hybrid recommendation models, not an established recommendation result.

zh.text: 该方法无需重新训练或修改权重，直接稀疏化混合LLM中剩余的全注意力层。每层保留近期窗口、固定前缀和一定数量的相关历史token，再用多目标搜索选择各层预算。实验覆盖三个模型家族的六个模型，规模为4B–397B，所选配置在21个长上下文数据集上保持基线准确率。256K上下文下，Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B和Ornith-1.0-397B解码最多分别提速2.22倍、2.23倍和2.06倍。逐层设置稀疏预算可在混合推荐模型中尝试，但论文没有推荐任务结果。

original_abstract.text: Generative retrieval predicts semantic identifiers for candidate entities. In local retail and food delivery, candidates must also be serviceable for a particular user at a particular time. Location, weather, and traffic reshape merchant and product supply, so a catalog-valid identifier may be infeasible for the current request. Post-generation filtering removes such candidates only after beam capacity and inference computation have been spent. We study retrieval over an explicitly materialized, request-time supply snapshot, where short output sequences leave little opportunity to amortize online constraint preparation. Our RTP-LLM pipeline compiles eligible residual-quantization identifiers into a compressed sparse row prefix index, overlaps CPU compilation with model prefill, and shares the uploaded index across beams. Legal expansions retain original-model log probabilities, and constraint states follow selected beam parents. We formalize snapshot-relative identifier validity and distinguish it from entity-level eligibility and freshness. The implementation generates three-token merchant identifiers. Historical evidence covers T+1 daily-refresh catalog constraints and subsequent request-scoped serving evaluations. In one matched-beam daily-constraint case, filtered merchants decrease from 170 of 299 candidates to 29 of 299; residual distance filtering motivates request-specific constraints. A different-host comparison with 30,000 supplied entries reports a 0.6 ms service-side latency increment, while client measurements expose additional request costs. Captured requests from three geographic settings characterize behavior across supply sizes and output widths. These observations span development stages and measurement boundaries. They establish a practical implementation and identify bottlenecks, but do not establish compute savings at matched retrieval quality.
original_abstract.source_title: Generative Retrieval under Real-Time Supply Constraints in Local Commerce

en.text: This retrieval pipeline constrains semantic-ID generation to a request-time snapshot of serviceable local merchants. Eligible IDs are compiled into a compressed sparse row prefix index, overlapped with model prefill and shared across beams while preserving original-model probabilities for legal expansions. A matched-beam daily-constraint case reduces filtered merchants from 170/299 to 29/299; remaining distance violations motivate request-specific constraints. A separate, different-host test with 30,000 entries adds 0.6 ms of service-side latency, excluding additional client costs. The implementation informs dynamic constrained retrieval, but validity is snapshot-relative and compute savings at matched retrieval quality are not established.

zh.text: 这套召回流程按请求时刻可服务的本地商家快照约束语义ID生成。它把合法ID编译成压缩稀疏行前缀索引，与模型预填充交叠执行并跨beam共享；合法扩展仍保留原模型概率。一个beam配置匹配的日更约束案例中，事后被过滤的商家从170/299降至29/299，剩余距离违规促使约束进一步细化到请求级。另一个不同主机、3万条供给的测试报告服务端延迟增加0.6毫秒，尚有额外客户端成本。可借鉴的是动态约束召回的实现；合法性只相对该快照成立，论文未证明同检索质量下节省计算。

original_abstract.text: Sequential recommenders are widely applied in real-world scenarios to model user preferences and behavior patterns based on user interactions. Recent advances in sequential recommendation enhance transformer-based models with latent reasoning to refine user representations by autoregressively generating intermediate reasoning vectors. However, exploring the optimal reasoning depth for diverse user histories remains challenging: existing methods typically employ a fixed number of reasoning steps for all users. This ``one-size-fits-all'' strategy often leads to suboptimal representation learning due to over-thinking in simple histories or under-thinking in complex ones. To address this issue, we propose DESRec, a deliberate latent reasoning framework that performs personalized latent reasoning to learn more informative reasoning states and enhance user modeling for sequential recommendation. Specifically, it designs a reasoning step selection module that identifies the optimal reasoning step for each user sequence during the training phase. Through a self-distillation mechanism, it compresses this most informative state into the final reasoning step, which serves as the final user representation for item ranking during inference. Moreover, it introduces a progressive preference extraction mechanism for personalized reasoning, which dynamically segments a user's history into a variable number of periods and summarizes each into a latent milestone representing the user's preference for that period. It will be used as the input of the subsequent reasoning. The number of milestones varies with the users' history, enabling a personalized reasoning over users' evolving interests. Extensive experimental results on six public datasets and four backbone recommenders demonstrate the superiority of DESRec over eight baseline models.
original_abstract.source_title: Deliberate Latent Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation

en.text: DESRec adapts latent reasoning to different user histories in sequential recommendation. During training it selects each sequence's most informative reasoning step and self-distills that state into the final step used for ranking. Progressive preference extraction also segments histories into a variable number of periods and summarizes them into latent milestones. Experiments span six public datasets, four backbone recommenders and eight baselines; the paper reports improved recommendation performance rather than an industrial scaling-law result.

zh.text: DESRec针对固定隐式推理步数难以适配不同用户历史的问题，在训练时为每条序列选择信息最充分的推理状态，再通过自蒸馏将其压入最终推理步骤。它还把用户历史动态分段，生成数量可变的偏好里程碑作为推理输入。论文在六个公开数据集、四种推荐骨干上与八个基线比较，为序列建模中的推理深度选择和知识压缩提供参考。

original_abstract.text: Gated-delta linear attention layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), and GDN-2 are tuned for GPUs, where small tensor-core tiles and fast vector registers make per-channel decay rescaling and sequential in-block solves cheap. On Google TPUs, which concentrate compute in wide $256 \times 256$ systolic matrix units backed by a slower vector unit, porting these layers directly leaves half of each matrix tile empty and bottlenecks on vector operations. We present \textbf{Systolic Linear Attention (SLA)}, which reshapes gated delta attention around the matrix unit by widening keys to $256$ with grouped value heads, grouping decay gates into four $64$-channel tiles, and computing the chunk solve entirely with block matrix products in a single fused kernel. On TPU v7x, a full \texttt{SLA-R4} layer runs $1.6\times$--$2.5\times$ faster than the open-source Tokamax KDA kernel ($1.4\times$--$2.4\times$ with exact chunk inversion), driven primarily by head sharing and kernel fusion. Across a $2{,}048$-chip TPU v7x pre-training study of sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models from $6.5\text{B}$ to $63.1\text{B}$ parameters, SLA trains $11\%$--$24\%$ faster than KDA at similar perplexity, and reaches slightly lower perplexity than KDA in smaller matched-seed runs.
original_abstract.source_title: Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs

en.text: SLA co-designs gated-delta linear attention for TPU systolic units: 256-wide keys shared by grouped value heads, tile-grouped decay gates and matrix-based chunk solves in a fused kernel. On TPU v7x, SLA-R4 layers are reported 1.6–2.5x faster than the open Tokamax KDA kernel. In a 2,048-chip study of 6.5B–63.1B sparse MoE models, training is 11–24% faster at similar perplexity. The results concern TPU-aligned attention design, not measured recommendation gains.

zh.text: SLA把门控Delta线性注意力与TPU矩阵单元共同设计：使用256维宽键并共享给多组值头，将衰减门按块组织，再把块内求解转成融合核中的矩阵运算。论文报告TPU v7x上单层较Tokamax KDA加速1.6—2.5倍，在2048芯片、6.5B至63.1B稀疏MoE预训练中以相近困惑度获得11%—24%的训练提速。可借鉴之处是按硬件形状重构序列算子，推荐任务收益仍需验证。

original_abstract.text: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.
original_abstract.source_title: Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism

en.text: FlexFloor reduces the time MoE rollout workers remain occupied after finishing their own responses because other workers still need their experts. Historical response lengths and memory limits guide batching and prompt placement; the system then releases workers progressively while preserving expert availability and communication correctness. Against verl, it reports 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied compute time and 52.74% higher generation throughput, with little observed rollout-reward variation. The transferable idea is to adapt expert-parallel resources to uneven request lengths; hardware and model scope are not specified in the abstract, and recommendation serving is not evaluated.

zh.text: FlexFloor解决MoE rollout中一类资源滞留：worker已生成完自己的响应，却因其他worker仍需它的专家而不能退出。系统用历史响应长度和内存限制安排批次与prompt，再逐步释放worker，同时维持专家可用性和通信正确性。相对verl，单位占用计算时间生成的响应token增加65.40%，生成吞吐提高52.74%，rollout reward变化较小。按请求长短弹性调整专家并行资源有迁移价值；摘要未说明模型与硬件范围，也未评测推荐服务。

original_abstract.text: Matrix optimizers such as Muon update whole weight matrices, which conflicts with the element- or row-wise sharding of data-parallel runtimes. Once parameters are sharded as well, matrix optimizers incur extra communication or repeated computation. We present DMuon, a matrix-granular optimizer runtime for PyTorch FSDP (ZeRO-2/3) and HSDP. DMuon assigns each matrix a unique owner, which performs the Newton--Schulz (NS) iteration and optimizer update on the full matrix, and balances the load across owners by computational cost. On HSDP, ownership is global across replicas, so the cluster keeps a single copy of gradients and optimizer state, and updated parameters are published across nodes as soon as they are ready, overlapping subsequent computation. This layout makes every collective sparse and variable in length, so DMuon schedules these collectives as their data becomes ready and routes them along the cluster's two-level network. On up to 256 H100 GPUs, across three dense LLMs and two VLA models, DMuon matches or exceeds the training throughput of PyTorch FSDP2 with AdamW, reaching 1.05$\times$ that of FSDP2 with AdamW at the median on 256 GPUs. The optimized parameter gathering and gradient reduction absorb the extra communication and computation a matrix optimizer requires. Against a gather-then-replicate Muon baseline, DMuon's throughput is 2.1 times as high at the median.
original_abstract.source_title: DMuon: Scaling Matrix Optimizers in Data Parallelism with Topology-Aware Matrix Ownership and Communication

en.text: DMuon reconciles whole-matrix optimization with sharded data-parallel training. Each matrix has one cost-balanced owner for its optimizer update; global ownership under HSDP avoids replicated optimizer work and state, while readiness-driven collectives follow the network topology. Across three dense LLMs and two VLA models on up to 256 H100s, it reports median throughput of 1.05x PyTorch FSDP2 with AdamW at 256 GPUs and 2.1x a gather-then-replicate Muon baseline. Matrix-level ownership and communication scheduling could help scale matrix optimizers for recommendation, but no recommendation or model-quality benefit is established here.

zh.text: DMuon处理整矩阵优化器与分片数据并行之间的冲突。每个矩阵只交给一个按计算成本分配的owner更新；HSDP下跨副本统一所有权，避免重复优化计算和状态存储，再按数据就绪顺序与网络拓扑调度通信。实验覆盖三个稠密LLM、两个VLA模型，最多使用256张H100；256卡时吞吐中位数为PyTorch FSDP2配AdamW的1.05倍，相对先聚合再复制的Muon基线为2.1倍。矩阵级任务分配可供推荐模型优化器扩展参考，但这里未验证推荐效果或模型质量收益。

original_abstract.text: Attention-FFN disaggregation (AFD) separates attention from the experts of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model and has been reported to raise decode throughput over colocated serving. Whether this advantage holds on rack-scale NVLink systems such as GB200 NVL72 remains unclear: prior results were obtained on other hardware, against narrower colocated baselines, or with analytical models, whereas production engines serve large MoE models on these systems with wide expert parallelism (wide EP). We build and tune FastAFD, an AFD engine for GB200 NVL72 that overlaps the MoE of one microbatch with the attention of the other, and compare it against the best vLLM wide EP setting. Experiments show that AFD has a throughput advantage of up to 1.17x over wide EP on Qwen3 and 1.16x on Qwen3.5, and matches it on MiniMax-M2.5. We derive an analytical model that predicts AFD throughput within 3% using only profiles of colocated vLLM, telling whether switching to AFD would pay off before deploying it. The model yields a concise insight: AFD's speedup factors into a batch gain (larger batches, since attention GPUs hold no expert weights), an overlap gain (shorter steps, since the MoE runs on the expert GPUs behind attention), and a disaggregation cost (the GPUs given to experts). AFD has the advantage when the two gains outweigh the cost. This view explains which models benefit from AFD, and shows that speculative decoding helps light-expert models most, where the enlarged overlap gain outweighs the larger disaggregation cost and adds a further 8% to AFD's advantage over wide EP. Looking ahead, serving the experts on accelerators that keep their weights in on-chip SRAM, such as the Groq LPX accelerators paired with Vera Rubin NVL72, would remove most of the disaggregation cost, raising the ideal speedup to 2.48x with speculative decoding. FastAFD is open source at https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/FastAFD.
original_abstract.source_title: FastAFD: When Does Attention-FFN Disaggregation Pay on Rack-Scale NVLink?

en.text: FastAFD tests when separating attention and MoE experts pays off on GB200 NVL72. It overlaps attention and expert computation across microbatches and compares against the best vLLM wide-expert-parallel configuration. Throughput gains reach 1.17x on Qwen3 and 1.16x on Qwen3.5, while MiniMax-M2.5 is matched. A model using colocated profiles predicts throughput within 3% and separates batch-size gains, overlap gains and the GPU cost of disaggregation. This gives a hardware-specific decision framework for sparse-model serving; the larger projected speedup with future SRAM-resident expert accelerators is not a measured result.

zh.text: FastAFD检验在GB200 NVL72上，把注意力与MoE专家拆开部署是否划算。它让不同微批次的注意力与专家计算交叠，并与调优后的最佳vLLM宽专家并行配置比较：Qwen3和Qwen3.5吞吐最多分别达到1.17倍和1.16倍，MiniMax-M2.5则相当。只用共置服务性能采样的模型，就能在3%误差内预测吞吐，并拆分批量增大、计算交叠和额外专家GPU的成本。它提供了依赖硬件的稀疏模型部署判断方法；未来SRAM驻留专家加速器的更大收益只是预测。

original_abstract.text: Looped transformers scale inference-time reasoning by repeatedly reusing a shared core, increasing computation without increasing parameter count. Serving prefilling and decoding with a uniform loop budget couples their costs. We present LoopDuet, a phase-dependent depth and training-free serving approach that selects the two budgets jointly while preserving decoding depth at prefilling boundaries. Our vLLM implementation gathers tokens requiring further recurrence into compact batches, turning the selected allocation into executable savings with existing weights and attention kernels. At runtime, a queue-age controller adjusts prefilling depth to retain quality as demand changes. Experiments on the full HotpotQA dataset with one A100-80GB demonstrate two benefits of this flexibility. First, separate phase budgets improve the quality--throughput trade-off: Huginn delivers 19\% more throughput than the fastest tested uniform setting meeting the same accuracy criterion, while a higher-throughput operating point gains 6.04 EM points over uniform depth eight at 97\% of its throughput. Second, the same execution mechanism retains more quality under load: on two evaluated OLMo arrival traces, adaptive prefilling gains 0.92--1.35 EM points over the most accurate tested fixed-depth controls at the same 100\% attainment of a one-second time-to-first-token target. Together, these results establish LoopDuet as a practical way to turn flexible model computation into higher serving capacity and better quality under load.
original_abstract.source_title: Not All Loops Cost the Same: Phase-Dependent Depth for Serving Looped Transformers

en.text: LoopDuet independently selects prefill and decode loop budgets for pretrained looped Transformers, compacts tokens needing further recurrence, and adapts prefill depth using queue age. In a vLLM evaluation on full HotpotQA with one A100-80GB, Huginn achieves 19% higher throughput than the fastest tested uniform-depth setting meeting the same accuracy criterion. Two tested OLMo arrival traces show better answer accuracy while all requests meet a one-second time-to-first-token target. These results concern the reported QA serving settings and motivate, but do not validate, phase-specific compute allocation for recommendation.

zh.text: LoopDuet 为已有循环 Transformer 分别选择预填充和解码的循环预算，把仍需循环的 token 压紧成批，并根据队列等待时间调整预填充深度。在单张 A100-80GB、完整 HotpotQA 的 vLLM 实验中，Huginn 相比满足同一准确率条件的最快已测统一深度设置，吞吐提高 19%。两条已测 OLMo 到达流量轨迹中，所有请求满足一秒首 token 延迟目标的同时，答案准确性更高。这些问答服务结果可启发推荐中的分阶段算力分配，不能直接视为推荐收益。

original_abstract.text: Post-training quantization (PTQ) reduces large language model (LLM) deployment costs, but preserving quality requires accounting for uneven weight sensitivity. Uniform PTQ uses one weight bit-width, importance-aware PTQ adjusts scales or reconstructs weights within that width, and column-wise mixed precision retains selected columns at higher precision. However, sensitivity varies within columns, so whole-column retention also protects less sensitive weights, while runtime outlier detection adds decoding overhead. We therefore introduce TileQuant, a training-free framework that assigns precision to hardware-aligned 2D weight tiles. Offline calibration provides input-activation-aware scoring from forward statistics for lower calibration cost and gradient-informed scoring from loss sensitivity for stronger quality preservation. Within each projection's retention budget, the highest-scoring tiles remain at 16-bit and the rest use 8-bit. The resulting map guides reconstruction into compact weight buffers, which the kernel reuses for native integer and 16-bit computation with local accumulation to reduce memory traffic. Experiments show that TileQuant reaches 2.66x the original model's generation throughput. Across language modeling, reasoning, long-context retrieval, and question answering, it preserves quality and surpasses quantized and original models on multiple tasks. These results support selecting precision units that capture local sensitivity while enabling efficient hardware execution. The implementation is: https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TileQuant
original_abstract.source_title: TileQuant: Tile as the Precision-Allocation Unit for LLM Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization

en.text: TileQuant allocates post-training precision to hardware-aligned 2D weight tiles rather than whole columns. Offline activation- or gradient-based sensitivity scoring selects tiles to retain at 16-bit, while the remaining tiles use 8-bit. Compact buffers and a mixed integer/16-bit kernel reduce memory traffic without runtime outlier detection. In the reported Llama-3.2-3B test on an A100-40GB with batch size one, generation throughput reaches 2.66× the original model; separate evaluations cover language modeling, reasoning, retrieval and QA quality. Its contribution is the joint choice of sensitivity granularity and execution layout; gains for recommendation models are untested.

zh.text: TileQuant 以硬件对齐的二维权重 tile 分配后训练量化精度，避免为了少量敏感权重而整列保留高精度。离线校准根据激活统计或梯度敏感度选择保留 16 位的 tile，其余使用 8 位，再通过紧凑缓冲区和整数/16 位混合内核减少访存，无需运行时检测异常值。Llama-3.2-3B 在 A100-40GB、批大小为一的测试中，生成吞吐达到原模型的 2.66 倍；质量评估另覆盖语言建模、推理、检索和问答。其借鉴点是联合设计敏感度粒度与执行布局，推荐模型收益尚待验证。

original_abstract.text: Looped Transformers reduce parameter count by repeatedly applying shared blocks, but parameter sharing alone does not determine how the results of repeated computation are reused. We take the depth-memory view of residual connections and analyze which representation is stored after each block application and how later reads weight it. A full block output contains both its input and its new update, so weighting that output also reweights the history already carried by the input. Reading individual updates instead, with the shared stack's input kept on a separate path, gives separate controls over input strength, total update weight, and allocation across updates. The Loopback Transformer implements these controls: geometric decay sets the total update weight and supplies a recency prior, and attention learns how to allocate that weight. On ClimbMix, Loopback reaches lower validation loss than standard Transformer baselines with 40-75% of their Transformer parameters (excluding token embeddings and the output head) at reference scales from 191M to 3B, with training tokens and executed depth matched. It also has higher mean accuracy over thirteen downstream tasks at 1.4B and 3B. At 191M, 374M, and 778M, it has the lowest validation loss and the highest thirteen-task mean among the standard Transformer and seven looped residual designs.
original_abstract.source_title: Loopback Transformer: Towards a Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers

en.text: Loopback separates the shared stack's input from individual residual updates, avoiding the repeated reweighting of history carried inside full block outputs. Geometric decay controls total update weight and recency, while attention allocates weight across updates. On ClimbMix, with training tokens and executed depth matched, it reaches lower validation loss than standard Transformers using 40–75% of their Transformer parameters, excluding embeddings and the output head, at reference scales of 191M–3B. It also improves mean accuracy on 13 tasks at 1.4B and 3B. The result informs parameter-efficient recurrent depth, not a demonstrated FLOP or latency reduction.

zh.text: Loopback把共享层堆栈的输入与各次残差更新分开保存，避免读取完整层输出时反复改变其中已有历史的权重。几何衰减控制总更新权重和近因偏好，注意力负责在不同更新间分配权重。在ClimbMix上，训练token数和实际执行深度匹配时，它以标准Transformer 40%–75%的Transformer参数达到更低验证损失；此参数口径不含嵌入与输出头，参考规模为191M–3B。1.4B和3B实验的13项任务平均准确率也更高。可借鉴的是循环深度的参数效率，不能据此推断FLOP或时延下降。

original_abstract.text: At context lengths of about 1M tokens, dense attention is costly in prefill and decoding, and training typically relies on long documents, which become scarcer as the target length increases. Most sparse attention methods score all preceding blocks or tokens, so their selection cost per query is $O(L)$ at context length $L$; hierarchical selection reduces it to $O(\log L)$, but prior trainable hierarchical methods report accuracy only within their training length. We propose RecSA (Recursive Sparse Attention), which builds a tree over the KV cache in which each node summarizes its subtree with one key and one mean-pooled value. The keys come from one pooler per layer, shared by all levels and distilled from dense attention. Each level above the tokens selects at most $k$ candidates, so each query has $O(\log L)$ selection cost and reads $O(\log L)$ entries; the summaries of unselected candidates share one softmax with the exact tokens. Each entry's RoPE position is its index among the candidates of its level, so at any length every relative distance stays within the range seen during training. Initialized from Qwen3-4B and trained on 0.62B tokens at the original model's 32K training length, RecSA outperforms all baselines on RULER at every length from 131K to 2M; at 1M, it scores 60.5, compared with 40.0 for the best baseline, Dense + DCA. With our optimized kernels, RecSA is faster than dense attention in end-to-end prefill and decoding from 64K to 2M; at 524K on one H200 GPU, it accelerates prefill by 3.2x and decoding by 3.8x.
original_abstract.source_title: Recursive Sparse Attention: Million-Token Length Extrapolation at Logarithmic Cost

en.text: RecSA builds a tree over the KV cache and recursively selects candidates, combining exact tokens with summaries of unselected subtrees in one softmax. A per-layer pooler shared across tree levels and level-relative positions keep selection and reads logarithmic in sequence length while supporting length extrapolation. Starting from Qwen3-4B, training uses 0.62B tokens at 32K length. At 1M tokens, RULER scores 60.5 versus 40.0 for the best baseline, Dense + DCA. At 524K on one H200, prefill and decoding are 3.2x and 3.8x faster than dense attention. Hierarchical retrieval offers a transferable long-history design, without recommendation evaluation.

zh.text: RecSA在KV缓存上建树，逐层筛选候选，把精确token与未选子树的摘要放入同一个softmax。每个模型层的池化器供树内所有层级共享，配合树层内相对位置，使选择与读取成本随序列长度对数增长，并支持长度外推。它从Qwen3-4B初始化，在32K长度下训练0.62B token；1M长度的RULER得分为60.5，最佳基线Dense + DCA为40.0。在单张H200、524K上下文下，相对稠密注意力，预填充与解码分别提速3.2倍和3.8倍。分层检索可供长行为历史建模参考，论文未评测推荐任务。

original_abstract.text: Sparsity and quantization reduce the cost of attention by skipping interactions and lowering the precision of those retained. However, useful interactions differ in their precision requirements: some tolerate low-precision scores while remaining sensitive to removal. We therefore introduce TriAttention, which assigns query-key (QK) tiles to skipping, 4-bit, or 8-bit computation, using 4-bit to retain quantization-tolerant interactions at lower cost. To represent compactly, we encode each head's computation regions with two diagonal-distance boundaries, keeping policy storage independent of context length. Offline calibration then evaluates candidate boundary pairs using normalized projected-output errors and complete-tile execution costs. Using these measurements, a model-wide allocator selects each head's boundaries to minimize calibration error under a shared computation budget. During prefill, the selected boundaries generate precision-grouped traversals for a fused kernel that skips omitted tiles and combines contributions from both QK precisions into one normalized attention output. The quantized keys and values prepared during prefill are then reused in a compressed key-value (KV) cache for decoding, reducing repeated reads of prompt data. Experiments show that TriAttention achieves end-to-end generation speedups of up to 7.88x over the Torch attention and 2.65x over the BF16 baseline. Meanwhile, TriAttention maintains quality comparable to the original models on general-purpose and long-context tasks. These results show how a compact retention-and-precision policy translates local sensitivities into attention computation and repeated KV-cache access. The implementation is https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/TriAttention.
original_abstract.source_title: TriAttention: Unified Sparse Mixed-Precision Attention for Long-Context LLM Inference

en.text: TriAttention jointly chooses which attention tiles to retain and whether to compute them at 4 or 8 bits. Two diagonal-distance boundaries per head encode the policy; offline calibration and model-wide allocation select boundaries under a shared compute budget. A fused prefill kernel combines both precisions, and decoding reuses the compressed KV cache. The abstract reports up to 2.65x end-to-end generation speedup over a BF16 baseline, with comparable general and long-context task quality, but does not specify the hardware or baseline implementation. Joint retention and precision allocation could inform long-sequence serving beyond LLMs.

zh.text: TriAttention联合决定哪些注意力块跳过、哪些用4位或8位计算。每个头只用两条对角距离边界描述策略，离线校准后在全模型共享计算预算下分配边界；融合预填充核合并两种精度的结果，解码复用压缩KV缓存。摘要报告相对BF16基线，端到端生成最多提速2.65倍，通用与长上下文任务质量相当，但未交代硬件和基线实现。联合分配保留范围与数值精度，可供其他长序列服务参考。

original_abstract.text: Embedding models compress variable-length text into fixed-size vector representations, but this compression can entangle semantic content with residual token-level information, such as artifacts arising from attention sink behavior. We propose a simple method that prepends trainable [DUMP] tokens to the input during embedding model training. The method keeps the model architecture, pooling strategy, and training loss unchanged, while optimizing the added tokens through the standard contrastive retrieval objective. By introducing trainable prefix positions that interact with regular tokens during encoding, [DUMP] tokens help reduce the influence of residual or uninformative token-level signals on the final retrieval representation. Experiments on standard retrieval and long-context benchmarks show that our method consistently improves over finetuned baselines across encoder and decoder embedding models. Further analysis shows that [DUMP] tokens alter token-level activation and attention patterns associated with low-information tokens. These results suggest that trainable prefix tokens provide a lightweight way to improve retrieval representations.
original_abstract.source_title: Reducing Representational Interference in Retrieval Embeddings with Trainable Prefix Tokens

en.text: The method prepends trainable [DUMP] tokens during embedding-model training to reduce residual, low-information token signals in the final retrieval representation. The backbone, pooling and loss remain unchanged; the added prefixes learn through the standard contrastive retrieval objective. Tests on standard and long-context retrieval benchmarks improve over fine-tuned baselines for both encoder and decoder embedding models. The approach provides a lightweight retrieval-representation intervention, rather than a scaling law or a demonstrated recommendation-system gain.

zh.text: 该方法在嵌入模型训练时加入可训练的 [DUMP] 前缀 token，减弱低信息量 token 的残余信号对最终检索向量的干扰。骨干结构、池化方式和损失保持不变，前缀通过原有对比检索目标学习。标准检索和长上下文检索实验中，encoder 与 decoder 嵌入模型均优于对应微调基线。它提供了轻量的检索表征修正方法，尚未建立扩展规律或验证推荐系统收益。

original_abstract.text: Generative recommendation retrieves items by autoregressively generating Semantic IDs(SIDs), where an RQ-VAE quantizes each item into a hierarchical SID sequence that the decoder generates level by level. We identify an overlooked bottleneck in this paradigm: the Semantic Quantization Gap(SQG). Quantization derives SIDs from rich continuous signals, including codebook centroids, local neighborhood geometry, and level-wise entropy. However, the decoder receives only discrete identifiers and loses the semantic structure that shaped them. This mismatch manifests in three ways: a grounding gap, where the decoder lacks semantic anchors when target-side information is limited; a neighborhood gap, where token-level supervision discards inter-item similarity and exacerbates exposure bias; and a difficulty gap, where computation is allocated uniformly despite generation difficulty diminishing with depth. To bridge the SQG, we propose BRIDGE. Codebook-grounded latent reasoning injects frozen quantizer centroids as semantic anchors before SID generation. Privileged EMA self-distillation transfers neighborhood-aware knowledge from a teacher to an on-policy student, preserving inter-item geometry while mitigating exposure bias. Effort-aware recurrence allocates more computation to the challenging early levels and progressively reduces it with depth. Across three Amazon benchmarks, BRIDGE improves Recall@10 and NDCG@10 by 10.9% and 9.7% on average over the strongest baseline (up to 12.6% and 10.7%). In a one-week online A/B experiment on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform with 5% traffic, BRIDGE improves eCPM by 0.65%.
original_abstract.source_title: BRIDGE: Bridging the Semantic Quantization Gap for Generative Recommendation

en.text: BRIDGE addresses the semantic information lost when a generative recommender sees only discrete semantic IDs. It supplies frozen codebook centroids as reasoning anchors, distills neighborhood structure through a privileged EMA teacher and allocates more recurrent computation to difficult early ID levels. Across three Amazon benchmarks, average Recall@10 and NDCG@10 improve by 10.9% and 9.7% over the strongest baseline. A one-week, 5%-traffic e-commerce advertising A/B test reports a 0.65% eCPM gain. The method suggests preserving quantizer geometry and varying compute by ID depth; the abstract gives no matched-budget efficiency result.

zh.text: BRIDGE处理生成推荐只接收离散语义ID、丢失量化阶段连续语义信息的问题。它把冻结的码本质心作为推理锚点，用带额外信息的EMA教师蒸馏邻域结构，并给较难的ID前几层分配更多循环计算。在三个Amazon数据集上，相对最强基线，Recall@10和NDCG@10平均提高10.9%和9.7%；电商广告平台一周、5%流量的A/B测试报告eCPM提高0.65%。可借鉴的是保留量化几何信息并按ID深度分配计算，摘要未给出等预算效率结论。

original_abstract.text: Attention is a core building block of frontier models and often dominates compute-bound prefill at long context. FP8 matrix instructions offer twice the peak throughput of BF16, but they accelerate only matrix multiplication, and the softmax between the two matrix multiplications of attention runs on vector units that FP8 does not accelerate. On the AMD Instinct MI355X, the vendor's AITER kernels reach 39% of peak FP8 matrix throughput at 32K tokens, compared with 49% in BF16. Attention is also more numerically sensitive to quantization than feed-forward layers, and unlike NVIDIA's Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, the MI355X does not track the completion of matrix instructions in hardware, so overlapping the softmax with the matrix multiplications depends on instruction order. We present ZYFA, prefill kernels for the MI355X built on three techniques: (1) computing each FP8 probability directly from its score with a multiply-add and an integer conversion instead of an exponential; (2) a ping-pong schedule in which one group of threads computes its softmax while another executes its matrix multiplications; and (3) scaling each block of probabilities up by a power of two before rounding, and normalizing by the sum of the rounded probabilities. On attention inputs captured from three models and timed at sustained clock speeds, ZYFA achieves 1.16-1.76x the throughput of AITER. On the Gaussian inputs of kernel benchmarks at 32K tokens, it achieves 1.26-1.37x at head dimension 128 and 1.99x for DeepSeek-style multi-head latent attention. The sustained clock of the MI355X depends on operand values, so throughput on random inputs does not reliably predict throughput on real model activations. At head dimension 128, ZYFA's numerical error is within a few percent of that of Composable Kernel and Triton and 62-78% lower than that of AITER's. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zyphra/zyfa.
original_abstract.source_title: ZYFA: Speed and Accuracy of FP8 FlashAttention on AMD CDNA4

en.text: ZYFA targets the softmax and scheduling bottlenecks that limit FP8 attention on AMD MI355X. It combines direct score-to-FP8 probability conversion, overlapping matrix multiplication with softmax, and blockwise probability scaling before rounding. On activations captured from three models at sustained clock speeds, its prefill kernels deliver 1.16–1.76x AITER throughput. At head dimension 128, numerical error is close to Composable Kernel and Triton and lower than AITER. The paper also shows why random-input benchmarks can mispredict real-activation throughput on this hardware. This is a hardware-specific attention-kernel result, not an end-to-end recommendation speedup.

zh.text: ZYFA针对AMD MI355X上FP8注意力的softmax与调度瓶颈，直接把分数转换为FP8概率，让矩阵乘法与softmax交叠执行，并在舍入前按块缩放概率。在三个模型的真实激活、持续运行频率下，预填充核吞吐为AITER的1.16–1.76倍；head dimension为128时，数值误差接近Composable Kernel和Triton，低于AITER。论文还指出该硬件的频率受操作数影响，随机输入跑分不能可靠预测真实吞吐。可借鉴的是硬件协同设计与评测方法，并非已经验证的推荐端到端加速。

original_abstract.text: Semantic information can enrich the identifiers and structured fields used by recommender systems. Semantic tokenization provides a structured representation of this information by converting LLM-derived user profiles into discrete tokens. In the common two-stage pipeline, the tokenizer is trained before the recommender. Its token assignments are then treated as fixed input features during recommendation training. As a result, the downstream recommender can learn how to use the assigned indices, but it cannot revise the semantic partition that produced them. Making this partition task-aware is difficult because nearest-code assignment is discrete, and unconstrained adaptation may also distort the geometry learned during pretraining. Moreover, a fixed token depth exposes the same semantic resolution to every interaction. We thus propose OptST (Optimizing Semantic Tokenization), which makes a pretrained tokenizer responsive to downstream recommendation. To revise token assignments without directly updating the pretrained encoder or base codebooks, OptST learns a low-rank deformation whose drift is limited by an anchor regularizer. Recommendation supervision reaches this transformation through a straight-through estimator, while prediction retains hard nearest-code assignments. Beyond adapting the assignments themselves, OptST selects an interaction-conditioned prefix to control how much residual detail is exposed to the recommender. Experiments on four public datasets show that OptST achieves the highest AUC among conventional and LLM-enhanced baselines. Its improvements also persist across different recommendation backbones. These results establish task-aware semantic tokenization as an effective interface between LLM-derived profiles and downstream recommendation models.
original_abstract.source_title: OptST: Optimizing Semantic Tokenization for LLM-Enhanced Recommendation

en.text: OptST adapts semantic tokenization of LLM-derived user profiles to downstream recommendation. A regularized low-rank transformation changes token assignments while keeping the pretrained encoder and base codebooks fixed; a straight-through estimator supplies training gradients, and an interaction-conditioned prefix selects semantic detail. It reports the highest AUC among evaluated conventional and LLM-enhanced baselines on four public datasets, with gains across backbones. The transferable idea is a task-aware interface between profile semantics and recommendation features.

zh.text: OptST 让大模型用户画像的语义分词随推荐任务调整。它固定预训练编码器和基础码本，用受约束的低秩变换调整 token 分配；训练时通过直通估计器传递梯度，再按当前交互选择保留多少层语义细节。在四个公开数据集和多种推荐骨干上，方法取得优于所比较基线的 AUC。它为语义画像与推荐特征之间的任务适配提供了具体接口。

original_abstract.text: Linear attention reduces the quadratic sequence-length complexity of softmax attention by maintaining fixed-size recurrent states. However, these states scale quadratically with the representation dimension and require repeated data transfers during decoding, creating a substantial GPU memory bottleneck. Recent studies have revealed significant low-rank redundancy in recurrent states, suggesting opportunities for more efficient representations. We introduce SPARE (State Projection for Accelerated Recurrent Execution), a training-free method that exploits this redundancy through fixed low-dimensional subspaces, heterogeneous rank allocation, and lightweight write compensation. By performing recurrent reads and updates directly on compact states, SPARE reduces memory traffic without online decomposition or dense-state reconstruction. SPARE achieves 2.55x full-model decoding speedup, 7.49x lower recurrent-kernel DRAM traffic, and 3.31x lower peak GPU memory, while preserving better associative-retrieval accuracy than structured pruning at matched memory budgets.
original_abstract.source_title: SPARE: Fast Linear Attention Decoding with Compact Recurrent States

en.text: SPARE targets the memory traffic of linear attention's recurrent states, whose size grows quadratically with representation width. Without retraining, it uses fixed low-dimensional subspaces, heterogeneous ranks and write compensation to read and update compressed states directly, avoiding online decomposition and dense reconstruction. The abstract reports 2.55x full-model decode speedup, 7.49x lower recurrent-kernel DRAM traffic and 3.31x lower peak GPU memory, but does not identify the speed baseline or hardware. Associative retrieval is better than structured pruning at matched memory budgets. The mechanism offers a candidate approach for compact long-history states.

zh.text: SPARE处理线性注意力递归状态随表示宽度平方增长、解码反复搬运状态的问题。它无需重新训练，用固定低维子空间、差异化秩分配和写入补偿直接读写压缩状态，省去在线分解与稠密状态重建。摘要报告整模型解码提速2.55倍、递归核DRAM流量降至约1/7.49、GPU峰值内存降至约1/3.31，但未说明速度基线和硬件。在相同内存预算下，其关联检索精度优于结构化剪枝；这一机制可作为长行为历史状态压缩的候选方案。
